description: This file is a shell script used for testing git's diff and merge-base functionalities, specifically examining behavior with symmetric differences, merge bases, and various edge cases in git operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, checks output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, checks error output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Runs cleanup commands after a test.
